Implemented on work/ready-five in /private/tmp/eyes4s-ready-five, source commit 40877c81, based on 0d119db2.

FormView is a plain private-constructor final class; of refuses duplicate IDs through existing DescriptorError.DuplicateFields. Checked ParameterSet supplies total descriptor accessors. Encoder no longer validates duplicates; decoding uses of and version-1 mirrors stay unchanged. FormDescriptorSuite/MethodDescriptorSuite 28, FormCodecSuite 5 and FormLawSuite 142 pass on JVM and JS. typeCheckErrors covers new/copy/Mirror rejection.

Qualification of the combined source tree: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true JDK25 rootJVM/Test/compile and rootJS/Test/compile passed; Studio JS app links; root hygiene/workflow checks, studioStyleCheck and checkBoundaries passed. Local sbt-only worktree metadata shim was required for existing sbt-git/JGit linked-worktree discovery; it is excluded from commits.

Ready for review and later merge. Full landing gate/API audit/consumer qualification belongs on the reviewed merged tree; no landing or closure claimed.
